saw_lines: Refurbished phone buyers check battery health and warranty before price, because a cheap phone with a dead battery is a return.
So the sale is won or lost on the first screen, where buyers either find battery health and warranty or leave.
Your site shows 88,018 reviews and 85%+ battery health, so put both on the first Google ad line for refurbished iPhone and Samsung searches.
ads_1: Search ads leading with battery health, warranty and 88,018 reviews, tested against price
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, Twitter and YouTube
